exports.name: InlineSwitch
exports.description:
A filter that is on or off, in a row of filters: the switch first, its
label after it, at least 44px tall on touch screens. (Settings put the
switch on the right: SwitchRow.)

props.name: rowClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the label; className goes to the switch.

props.description: Extra classes for the label; className goes to the switch.

exports.name: Switch
exports.description:
A 36×20 toggle with a 44px hit area on touch screens; the off track is the
field border tone (`input`, 3:1 on the page), the on track primary in light
mode and brand in dark mode (see Checkbox), focus the shared 2px outline.

exports.name: SwitchList
exports.description: SwitchRows (with `inset`) divided by rules, in a Card or a bordered box.

props.name: bordered
props.description: A rounded border around the list, for a list that is not already in a Card.

props.description: A rounded border around the list, for a list that is not already in a Card.

exports.name: SwitchRow
exports.description:
A setting that is on or off: what it is (and what it does) on the left,
the switch on the right, level with the first line of the label. Several
of them stack in a SwitchList.

props.name: badge
props.description: Beside the label: a Badge such as "Always on".

props.name: before
props.description: A control that belongs to the switch (a minutes field for "Alert when late"), beside it on wide screens and under the label on phones.

props.name: description
props.description: What it does, under the name.

props.name: inset
props.description: Padding for a row in a SwitchList.

props.name: rowClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the row; className goes to the switch.
